include_drawings.description: Include drawings already rendered on the live TradingView chart (default true). When false the same live TradingView path captures a clean, undrawn chart.

include_studies.description: Include studies already rendered on the live TradingView chart (default true). When false the same TradingView path captures without them.

inline_image.description: Set false to skip the inline image copy (default true). The operator-facing display_markdown is returned either way.
